product_context: Linear is a project-management tracker for software teams.

archetypes.name: Resigned Satisfied
archetypes.profile: Customers describe the product as fine while sadness leads the emotion profile. They stay because switching costs more than the disappointment.
representative_quotes: The product is fine, I guess. It works.

hidden_asks.title: Acknowledgement of quiet loyalty
hidden_asks.description: The Resigned Satisfied archetype praises the product in understatement while scoring high on sadness. No review asks for a loyalty program, but the pattern implies they want their tenure to count for something.

hidden_asks.title: A place to ask naive questions
hidden_asks.description: Isolation language sits next to compliments on docs. The unmet need is belonging during onboarding, not another tutorial page.

hidden_asks.title: Recoverability they can trust
hidden_asks.description: Fear-led reviews organize nightly exports around history loss. They call the product good and still do not trust recovery.
